mapper.select: SELECT TERM_GROUP_ID AS "termGroupId" , TERM_ID AS "termId" , JNL_DATE AS "jnlDate" , JNL_TIME AS "jnlTime" , DEVICE_ID AS "deviceId" , ERR_GROUP_CD AS "errGroupCd" , MODULE_TYPE_CD AS "moduleTypeCd" , FAULT_CLASS_CD AS "faultClassCd" , ERR_CD AS "errCd" , ATM_CO_CD AS "atmCoCd" , MODEL_CD AS "modelCd" FROM T_FAULT_ANALYSIS WHERE STATUS = '0' AND REQUEST_FLAG = '0' AND AUTO_REQUEST IN ('1','2') AND TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND TERM_ID = #{termId} AND JNL_DATE = #{jnlDate} AND JNL_TIME = #{jnlTime}

SELECT NVL(SERVICE_CALL , '0') AS "serviceCall" , NVL(SECURITY_CALL, '0') AS "securityCall" , NVL(ATM_CALL , '0') AS "atmCall" , ERR_GROUP_NAME AS "errGroupName" FROM T_ERRORGROUP WHERE LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ERR_GROUP_CD = #{errGroupCd}
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_HOLIDAY WHERE GROUP_CD IN (#{termGroupId}, '00001') AND HOLIDAY_DATE = #{today} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL

SELECT R.ATM_CO_FLAG AS "atmCoFlag" , R.OURSRC_FLAG AS "oursrcFlag" , R.GUARD_FLAG AS "guardFlag" , C.CCTV_SET_FLAG AS "cctvSetFlag" , C.MANAGE_TYPE_CD AS "manageTypeCd" , C.OPERATION_TYPE_CD AS "operationTypeCd" FROM T_AUTOREQUESTCHECK R LEFT JOIN T_ATM A ON A.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND A.TERM_ID = #{termId} LEFT JOIN T_CORNER C ON C.TERM_GROUP_ID = A.TERM_GROUP_ID AND C.CORNER_CD = A.CORNER_CD WHERE R.BANK_CD = #{bankCd} AND R.MANAGE_TYPE_CD = C.MANAGE_TYPE_CD
AND ( C.MANAGE_TYPE_CD = '2' OR ( C.MANAGE_TYPE_CD != '2' AND C.OPERATION_TYPE_CD IN ('1','2','3') AND R.OPERATION_TYPE_CD = '1' AND ( (#{jnlTime6} BETWEEN R.BANK_START_TIME AND R.BANK_END_TIME AND R.FAULT_CLASS_CD = #{faultClassCd}) OR (NOT (#{jnlTime6} BETWEEN R.BANK_START_TIME AND R.BANK_END_TIME) AND R.FAULT_TIME_CD = '2') ) ) )
AND C.OPERATION_TYPE_CD IN ('1','2','3') AND R.OPERATION_TYPE_CD = '1' AND R.FAULT_TIME_CD = '2'
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN #{providerType} = '1' THEN A.ATM_CO_CD WHEN #{providerType} = '2' THEN B.GUARD_CO_CD WHEN #{providerType} = '3' THEN B.OUTSRC_CO_CD END FROM T_ATM A, T_CORNER B WHERE A.TERM_GROUP_ID = B.TERM_GROUP_ID AND A.CORNER_CD = B.CORNER_CD AND A.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND A.TERM_ID = #{termId}
AND B.MAINT_TYPE_CD = '1'
SELECT DEVICE_NAME FROM T_ATM_UNIT WHERE DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
